verdict.rationale: Sentry's homepage describes Seer as its own built-in debugging agent that finds root causes and generates merge-ready patches, so users can hand it debugging and fix tasks. The only support is two marketing lines, with no docs on how tasks are delegated or what Seer covers. The Agents Insights material is about monitoring a customer's own agents, not a built-in assistant, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: first-party Seer documentation (how to invoke it, what tasks it can take on, limits), any delegation scope beyond root-cause analysis and patch generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Find root causes and fix production issues with [Seer, our debugging agent](https://sentry.io/product/seer/).
Fixes what’s broken while you ship what’s next – generating precise, merge-ready patches.
